versions.headline: Design system, animations, onboarding, and crash reporting.
highlights: New design system with consistent spacing, typography, and interactive states
Spring animations on panels, dropdowns, and the overlay entrance
First-launch setup flow to get started quickly
Crash detection with opt-in email reporting
What is new modal after each update

versions.headline: The global hotkey now works on GNOME Wayland, and clipboard sharing to Linux is fixed.
highlights: The global hotkey now works on GNOME Wayland, no Xorg session needed
Clips sent from a Mac to a Linux device no longer fail with an access error
Settings now shows the SynaptCore version and warns if it needs an update

versions.headline: Pair devices that cannot find each other automatically.
highlights: Pairing now works across different Wi-Fi bands using manual IP entry or invite codes
SynaptClip only lists devices that are paired and online

versions.headline: Automatic updates and a lighter memory footprint.
highlights: Synapt now updates itself, with an option to check automatically
Uses noticeably less memory while running in the background
Pairing requests now show a notification even when the overlay is hidden

versions.headline: Safer quitting on macOS.
highlights: Cmd+Q no longer quits Synapt by accident; quit from the menu bar icon instead
Quitting from the menu bar now asks for confirmation

versions.headline: Share clipboard items between devices with SynaptClip.
highlights: Send clips between your devices when SynaptClip is installed
Settings and the overlay show whether SynaptClip is connected
Now available for Mac as a signed universal app

versions.headline: Pick a device with @ and work with its files and apps.
highlights: Type @ to pick a device and search its shared files
Press the right arrow on a file to open it, show it in its folder, or send it to several devices
Launch apps on another device and follow transfers in a progress card

versions.headline: See indexing progress and app icons.
highlights: A progress bar shows while your files and apps are being indexed
Applications now show their icons in results
Pairing and the duplicate tray icon on Windows are fixed

versions.headline: A complete Settings page, themes, and app search.
highlights: Search and launch installed applications
Choose dark, light, or system theme, and start Synapt on login
Get notified when transfers finish and devices pair or come online

versions.headline: Search results now appear reliably.
highlights: File search now returns results as soon as indexing finishes
Synapt and SynaptClip share a single tray icon
A refreshed look that matches SynaptClip

versions.headline: Faster, resumable file transfers.
highlights: Large transfers resume where they left off after a dropped connection
Send several files at once and track each one
Synapt now runs on macOS

versions.headline: Search your files and your other devices.
highlights: Fast file search that tolerates typos
Search a paired device's shared files with @device
Type a calculation to get the answer instantly

versions.headline: The first Synapt release.
highlights: Find other devices on your network and pair them with a verification code
Send files between paired devices, encrypted end to end
Choose which folders paired devices can access
